entry.title: A new Census graduate study strengthens the U.S. early-career warning with initial employment and earnings outcomes, while broad job-posting research still finds no distinct AI-driven decline. The answer is now sharper and more bounded.

First public evidence map: early-career hiring is the sharpest U.S. warning, but its AI attribution is unresolved; firm reports and Danish records show task change without a common wage-or-hours result.
